mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.collect_count AS collectCount, p.is_top AS isTop, p.is_essence AS isEssence, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS userName, u.name AS userNickname, u.avatar AS userAvatar, u.phone AS userPhone, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_reply r WHERE r.post_id = p.id AND r.is_deleted = 0) AS replyCount FROM forum_post p LEFT JOIN user_info u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM forum_post WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_post SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE forum_post SET is_top = #{isTop}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE forum_post SET is_essence = #{isEssence}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalPostCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayPostCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_top = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS topPostCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_essence = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS essencePostCount FROM forum_post WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_reply WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE post_reply SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
